scope: Supplemental source review for later Rules tasks. Does not replace the accepted eASLRB 3.01 baseline or certify live command support.

documents.editionNote: Filename identifies 3.14; the credits on physical page 5 print Version 3.13, January 2026. Preserve both facts; do not silently relabel either.
documents.reviewMethod: Column-ordered text extraction plus visual review of complete rendered physical pages 291 and 292 (printed G16-G17).
findings: Packing uses designated squad Mules, eligible Guns or listed SW, and qualified Personnel in the same terrain and Location. Normal Guns require a non-PRC Good Order same-nationality crew; G10.7 substitutes a qualified MMC for listed SW.

G10.3 period is max(1, 12 minus M# plus one for non-MTR), doubled at night. G10.7 SW use M# 12. Start/resume/release uses the first-RPh work step; losing crew Pack-TI invalidates only the current Game Turn.

Midpoint unloading/loading uses the following Player-Turn RPh, not necessarily a first-RPh. Assembly/limber/repair exceptions, reversal, involuntary unloading, prohibited terrain, vulnerability and cumulative Low Ammo remain explicit later integration requirements.
documents.interpretation: G10.33 reversal uses net complete Game Turns already spent, with the ordinary minimum. Its specific elapsed-time rule does not apply the night multiplier a second time. Involuntary unloading instead requires the normal full G10.3 period.
documents.executionSupport: Pending: this source review resolves missing text only. D3.2-D3.4 must integrate real actors, consequences and command/guide evidence.

additionalReviews.method: Text extraction checked for Horse/Personnel separation, counter sizes and hidden/concealed handling. No new artwork or PDF copied into the repository.
additionalReviews.finding: Horse counters are separate from their Personnel Riders; A13.32 distinguishes squad, HS and SMC capacities. G10-designated Mules retain distinct identities and cannot create an SMC Mule. Movement, Riders, reduction and vulnerability remain pending execution.

additionalReviews.method: Rechecked the existing column-ordered extraction for the vulnerability table and both printed recovery examples; prior complete-page visual review remains recorded above.
additionalReviews.finding: Forced unloading requires a full ordinary recovery period, whereas a casualty after the Gun has already unloaded does not erase its existing progress. Low Ammo occurrences accumulate. Involuntary-unload terrain eliminates listed SW except on a Bank. No live casualty, restart, CA or ammunition integration is certified.

additionalReviews.method: Text extraction reviewed for MMC use, captured/non-qualified-use requirements and physical covered-arc distinctions. This adds no visual-review claim and does not replace the accepted baseline.
additionalReviews.finding: Same-nationality MMC qualification is bounded to MMG, HMG and light mortars. C9.2 gives light mortars no CA; A9.21 SW MG fire restrictions do not establish a physical Gun facing. Foreign/SSR exceptions and the specialized 37mm INF SW representation remain pending; no live command is admitted.

additionalReviews.method: Text review of G10.41 and both printed examples; ASOP 1.13B extraction checked for start/release versus halfway timing. Existing G10 full-page visual review is retained.
additionalReviews.finding: An already-unloaded Gun retains its existing Unpacking progress after Mule casualties, as the Turn 5 example releases in Turn 6. Further loss during full recovery does not restart its duration. Casualty effects occur immediately and do not create a new ASOP work step. Live source authentication, atomic effects and replacement-Mule routes remain pending.
